newsitem.title: USA: Roche unit, Gilead start trial.
newsitem.headline: Roche unit, Gilead start trial.

text.p: F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd and Gilead Sciences Inc on Thursday said they have begun Phase II human tests for an oral drug to treat and prevent viral influenza, called GS 4104.
The tests consist of two studies in which healthy volunteers will receive oral capsules of GS 4104 or placebo once or twice daily, the companies said in a statement.

One study is designed to determine the effect of GS 4104 in reducing symptoms after exposure to influenza. The other study assesses the effect of GS 4104 in preventing infection by administering the drug before exposure to influenza.
F. Hoffmann-La Roche, based in Basel, Switzerland, is part of global pharmaceutical conglomerate Roche Holding Ltd.
